Part of a Rangers job is hunting wildlife. Practise this by helping Zho to kill an elusive [[Yeti]].

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = factions
| profession = Ranger
| primary = y
| secondary = n
}}

===Objectives===
* Speak to Zho again when you are ready to begin hunting the Yeti.
* Help Zho hunt down and kill the Yeti.
* See Zho for your reward.

===Early benefits===
*{{skill icon|Read the Wind}}
*{{skill icon|Flame Trap}}

===Reward===
* 1,500 [[Experience]]
* 100 [[Gold]]
* [[Monastery Credit]]

==Walkthrough==
Talk with Zho, then follow her south to the yeti. It's level 10 but alone, so should be an easy kill for a full party. You won't have enough time to put down more than one trap, so don't be bothered really.

==NPCs==
===Foes===
*{{W}} 10 (24) [[Wild Yeti]]

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Zho
:''"For months I have been trying to trap a particularly elusive [[Wild Yeti|Yeti]]. I have set rabbit traps to lure him, but I find the traps broken and the rabbits gone. Perhaps together we can do what I have been unable to alone."''

:''"I suggest you take some time to [[Read the Wind|review]] [[Flame Trap|the skills]] I am about to give you. When you are ready to go, [[Zho|speak with me]] again."''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = I'm happy to help.
| decline = Sorry, Yeti scare me.
| ask = Just stay close and be prepared to kill the [[Wild Yeti|Yeti]] when it shows itself.
}}

===Intermediate dialogue===
;Zho
:''"I hope the Yeti has not escaped while you were busy daydreaming. Come! Let us go and find the beast."''

'''Zho''': ''"I noticed some tracks nearby; I think it is close, now."''

'''Zho''': ''"There it is! Attack!"''

===Reward dialogue===
;Zho
:''"You might just make a good Ranger some day."''

==Notes==
*[[Dragon Festival]] quests have been known to interfere with the yeti spawning.

==Trivia==
*The traps that [[Zho]] set were in fact broken by [[Sujun]] and the character earlier, during the quest [[Free the Fur]].
